newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, more due.
newsitem.headline: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, more due.

text.p: Four ships are loading a total of 86,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, French port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat is for export to West Africa and Italy, they said.

Three more ships are expected in port by May 9 to load around 34,000 tonnes of wheat. The destination was not specified. One vessel is also due in port by May 9 to load around 60,000 tonnes of barley.
